input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

Riven has already decided to leave her home and begin her journey toward becoming a warrior.

Her original character design must remain unchanged.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Her sword is secured naturally at her side.

Riven carries a small practical travel bag with only basic belongings.

Her physical performance should communicate determination and quiet confidence.

She is not frightened.

She is not emotionally overwhelmed.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.


FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary visual reference for Riven's father.

Preserve his recognizable facial appearance, age, hairstyle, facial hair, body proportions, clothing design, and grounded former-warrior appearance.

He understands that Riven has chosen to leave.

He does not try to stop her.

He remains calm, restrained, and emotionally controlled.

His concern for Riven should be communicated through his eyes, posture, and silence rather than dramatic behavior.

Do not portray him as frail.

Do not portray him as overly emotional.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided village/home reference as the environmental reference.

The entire scene takes place around Riven's family cottage and the village road directly outside it.

Maintain the recognizable environment:

weathered timber-and-stone cottage,
rough stone foundation,
sloped roof,
small chimney,
wooden door,
nearby chopping block,
stacked firewood,
simple wooden fence,
large old tree,
dirt-and-grass yard,
and the familiar road leading away from the village through the valley.

The surrounding settlement is peaceful.

Rugged mountains rise beyond the broad green valley.

Cool early-morning daylight.

Light mountain mist.

Soft chimney smoke.

Gentle wind moving through grass, clothing, and hair.

The road leading away from the cottage must remain clearly visible.

No army appears in this scene.

No soldiers appear in this scene.

No additional characters are needed.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight.

Realistic travel equipment.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, sword consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

Use restrained cinematic camera movement.

Allow quiet moments to breathe naturally.

Avoid excessive cuts.

Avoid rapid montage.

Avoid exaggerated slow motion.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

No glowing weapons.

All character dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Every written dialogue line must be spoken verbatim by the specified character.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No Chinese or Mandarin.

No Vietnamese.

No Japanese.

No Korean.

No other spoken language.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background intelligible conversations.

Accurate visible lip synchronization whenever a character speaks.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Audio should remain natural and restrained:

gentle mountain wind,
birds,
quiet village ambience,
soft footsteps on dirt,
subtle leather movement,
subtle sword and travel equipment movement.

Do not make the scene melodramatic.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open in the quiet early morning outside Riven's family cottage.

Riven is already prepared to leave.

Her sword is secured at her side.

A small practical travel bag rests near the cottage doorway.

Riven reaches down and picks up the travel bag.

She straightens and steps away from the cottage.

Her father is already outside nearby.

They see each other.

Neither character immediately speaks.

There is no long goodbye.

There is no argument.

There is no hug.

There is no explanation of Riven's decision.

Father already understands.

Riven gives him a small acknowledging look.

Then she turns toward the road and begins walking away from home.

Father allows her to go.

Only after Riven has started walking does he call:

"Riven."

Riven stops and looks back.

Father looks directly at her and says:

"Remember who you fight for."

This is the only lesson he gives her.

Riven understands the connection to what he taught her when she was young.

Do not use a flashback.

Do not use voice-over.

Do not explain the connection verbally.

Riven responds only with a small deliberate nod.

She turns forward again.

Then she continues down the road leading away from the village.

She looks back at home only once.

Then she turns forward and keeps walking.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — THE BAG

Begin close to the ground beside the cottage doorway.

A small practical travel bag rests there.

Riven's hand enters frame.

She grips the bag firmly.

She lifts it.

Reveal Adult Riven as she straightens.

Her sword is already secured naturally at her side.

She is fully prepared to travel.

Do not show her packing.

Do not show her preparing equipment.

The decision has already been made.

Riven briefly looks toward the cottage.

Her expression remains restrained.

This is the home where she grew up.

She does not linger.

Riven turns away from the doorway and walks into the yard.


Shot 2 — FATHER

As Riven crosses the yard, reveal her father nearby.

He is already outside.

He is calm.

Riven notices him.

She stops naturally.

Father and daughter face each other across the familiar yard.

Neither speaks.

Do not make the moment theatrical.

No crying.

No embrace.

No dramatic farewell gesture.

No sentimental smile.

Father's eyes briefly move toward Riven's travel bag.

Then toward the sword at her side.

Then back to Riven.

He understands.

Riven gives him a small acknowledging nod.

Father returns the gesture subtly.

Nothing else is needed.

Riven turns away.

She walks toward the road.


Shot 3 — REMEMBER

Follow Riven from behind as she begins walking away from the cottage.

Her pace is steady.

Her travel bag and sword move naturally with each step.

Father remains behind.

Do not have him follow her.

Allow Riven to create some physical distance from the cottage.

Then Father calls clearly:

"Riven."

Riven stops.

Her footsteps cease.

She does not immediately turn her entire body.

She first turns her head slightly.

Then she turns enough to look back toward her father.

Cut to Father standing near the cottage.

He looks directly at Riven.

His expression is calm and serious.

Father says:

"Remember who you fight for."

No additional words.

Cut back to Riven.

She looks at him.

The words clearly matter to her.

Keep the reaction subtle.

No tears.

No speech.

No smile.

Riven gives one small deliberate nod.

She turns forward again.


Shot 4 — THE ROAD

Riven continues walking.

Move behind her.

The familiar village road stretches ahead through the valley.

The cottage and her father gradually become farther behind.

Riven keeps moving forward.

Her pace remains steady.

After traveling farther along the road, Riven slows slightly.

She looks back once.

Show her perspective:

the family cottage,
the familiar training yard,
and her father still standing near the home.

He has not followed her.

He does not wave dramatically.

He simply watches.

Return to Riven.

Hold briefly on her face.

She takes in the sight of home one final time.

Then Riven turns forward.

Her expression settles into determination.

She continues along the road.

The camera remains behind her.

The village slowly recedes.

The road opens toward the broad valley and distant mountains.

Riven does not stop again.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven has left her family cottage.

Her sword remains secured at her side.

She carries a small practical travel bag.

Her father remains behind at the family home.

Their goodbye was quiet and restrained.

There was no argument.

There was no embrace.

There was no long conversation.

Father's only spoken line was:

"Riven."

followed by:

"Remember who you fight for."

Riven acknowledged him silently.

She looked back at home once.

Then she turned forward again.

End with Riven walking alone along the road leading away from her village.

She has not yet reached the army.

She has not yet entered military training.

She has not yet experienced real warfare.


=== MOOD ===

Quiet.

Grounded.

Restrained.

Purposeful.

Bittersweet without sentimentality.

The scene is not about sadness.

It is about crossing a threshold.

Riven is leaving the protected world of her childhood and moving toward the life she has chosen.

The emotional progression is:

Riven picks up her travel bag
→ sees Father
→ silent understanding
→ turns toward the road
→ begins leaving
→ "Riven."
→ she looks back
→ "Remember who you fight for."
→ silent nod
→ Riven continues
→ one final look at home
→ turns forward
→ keeps walking.

Do not introduce the army.

Do not introduce soldiers.

Do not add recruitment.

Do not show military training.

Do not add another conversation.

Do not have Riven verbally answer Father's final lesson.

Do not use flashbacks.

Do not use narration.

Do not turn the goodbye into a sentimental farewell.

End with Riven continuing forward alone.
